name: Smoked Salmon Bowl with Ginger Rice, Edamame, Mango, Veggies & Spicy Mayo (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 4 medium and 8 mini food storage containers.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (2 inch) piece ginger root
1 English cucumber
1 bunch radish

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger. Place in a medium saucepan.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and add to the saucepan with the ginger. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup jasmine rice
2 cups chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and slice cucumber crosswise into thin rounds. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and slice radishes crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the cucumber, along with sesame seeds and vinegar, then stir to combine the salad. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp sesame seeds
2 tsp rice vinegar

instructions.primary_message: Peel mangoes and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; medium dice the flesh. Set aside.
Place edamame in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to thaw. Set aside to drain.
Place mayo and chili garlic sauce in a small bowl, then whisk to combine the spicy mayo. Divide between 4 of the mini containers and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup mayonnaise
4 tsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Divide soy sauce between remaining mini containers and set aside.
When the rice is done, transfer to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. Set aside to cool, about 10 minutes.

When the rice is cool, divide between the medium storage containers along with cucumber-radish salad, mango, edamame, smoked salmon, spicy mayo, and soy sauce. Cover and refrigerate until ready to eat. Enjoy!
